phase: after source/previous-result inspection, before candidate implementation or fresh evaluation
question: Can an independent bounded raster residual measurement flag unmodeled conductor-like strokes on an exact registered guide even when the supplied human verdict says pass?
observations: The existing review reconstructs source/guide bytes but delegates all image-content observations to a supplied verdict.
Yesterday's decoder restriction is present in the new pinned upstream head; the prior all-pass extra-conductor diagnostic remained accepted.
premises: Same-canvas, opaque PNGs preserve fixed registration within two pixels.
Dark residual ink outside a three-pixel expansion of known guide ink is a measurable mismatch, not proof of an electrical connection.
competing_explanations: New long ink may be an unexpected conductor.
New long ink may instead be annotation, texture, scanning artifacts or misregistration; that still requires review rather than automatic acceptance.
candidate: Thresholded luminance masks plus bounded morphology and connected-component/axis-run measurement. Keep full source reconstruction and human review mandatory; never assign net identity from pixels. Opt in with independent_raster=True; default published behavior is unchanged.
pre_execution_amendment: After initial implementation and before first development execution, parent required explicit opt-in. The research API now uses independent_raster=False by default, without adding a CLI option or changing the production workflow.
prediction: Development long orthogonal added strokes outside guide ink reject despite all-pass verdict; exact guide and a light paper-tone change remain accepted; shifts, missing ink, transparent images, wrong canvas and ambiguous small ink abstain.
falsifier: An in-scope long residual stroke is accepted, an ambiguous result becomes a positive visual claim, or the source/guide/verdict contract is bypassed.
known_limits: No full pin graph, OCR, conductor identity, circuit simulation, physical clearance or electrical qualification.
Features inside the three-pixel guide corridor, short features, faint features above threshold and overlapping ink can escape this measurement.
No absence-of-extra-connections proof or calibrated probabilities. Clean means only no mismatch detected within this declared scope.

reasoning_modes.deduction: Acceptance requires existing human acceptance AND a clear-within-scope measurement.
reasoning_modes.induction: Fresh finite synthetic observations only; no claim of general drawing accuracy.
reasoning_modes.abduction: Keep conductor and nonconductor explanations for added dark strokes.
reasoning_modes.analogy: Compare registered drawing to a change mask: identity and coordinates transfer; electrical semantics do not.

independent_evaluation.policy: Coder A will not open fresh holdout; freeze candidate hashes before independent run; no tuning to held-out feedback.

resource_bounds: Local synthetic development images and existing dependencies only. At most one fixed canvas, 25000 residual pixels, 4096 components; no model, network execution, remote writes or deployment.

simplex.reason: No mixture weights or barycentric representation needed.
simplex.invariant: Boolean admission and human gates are unchanged.

n_ality.reason: Keep source identity, reviewer judgment and independent raster evidence as separate axes.
n_ality.invariant: Matching image bytes do not prove correct wiring.

continuum.reason: Finite raster coordinates and declared morphology tolerances approximate continuous strokes.
continuum.invariant: Unknown registration or out-of-scope resolution cannot pass.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Measured mismatch thresholds are explicit deterministic rules, not confidence membership.

rollback: Discard the isolated candidate module and its one integration call; no remote state is changed.
